answer: Weight votes by staked collateral that unlocks slowly. Each new identity must bridge a deposit of 50 tokens into escrow for 30 days, and any identity caught colluding has that deposit burned. A forger running 1,000 fake accounts therefore ties up 50,000 tokens and risks losing all of it, leaving hollow accounts expensive to keep. An honest agent runs one account, stakes once, and is never slashed, so its cost stays negligible.
